judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: O valor de busca vindo de GET é concatenado entre aspas no LIKE. A entrada %' OR 1=1 -- encerra o literal e altera o predicado SQL
planted.rationale: F2 at lib.php:80-85 (planted :82) explains the quote break-out of the concatenated LIKE term. Fixed with a mysqli prepared statement, LIKE ? and bind_param of '%'.$busca.'%' (delivered lib.php:96-104); probe corrigida=true. The %/_ wildcards are deliberately left unescaped (Decisions, 'Curingas LIKE'). The matrix note would call that partial, but C3 follows the probe, as in BO, BQ and BS. No COMP comes from this fix.

planted.report_excerpt: A busca é interpolada diretamente tanto em value="..." quanto no parágrafo de resultados. Um valor como "><script>alert(1)</script> encerra o atributo e insere marcação executável
planted.rationale: F3 at index.php:79-82 names both output points and the attribute break-out. Both now go through escaparHtml(), which is htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE and UTF-8 (delivered index.php:95, :98). Swapping the other htmlspecialchars calls for the helper changes no output on PHP 8.1+, whose default flags are the same, so there is no COMP-006.

planted.report_excerpt: Titulo e nome do técnico são passados diretamente a fputcsv. Esse escape protege a estrutura do CSV, mas uma célula começando por =, +, - ou @ ainda pode ser interpretada como fórmula por programas de planilha.
planted.rationale: F8 at lib.php:138-143 (planted :140) states the formula-injection mechanism. textoCsvSeguro() prefixes an apostrophe to title and technician cells that start with = + - @ (also after leading spaces or ASCII control characters) and leaves the bare '-' placeholder alone (delivered lib.php:139-145, 172, 174); probe corrigida=true. Header, column order, delimiter and id order are unchanged, so C5 is full. There is no PEN-001 because the '-' placeholder is preserved, unlike G, V, AU and AV.

planted.report_excerpt: session_start abre a sessão e o login apenas grava uid/papel nela. Não existe session_regenerate_id na transição para autenticado. Se um atacante conseguir fixar um identificador de sessão conhecido no navegador da vítima, ele continua identificando a sessão após o login.
planted.rationale: F5 at index.php:15-26 (planted :24) describes session fixation. session_regenerate_id(true) is called after a successful autenticar() and before uid/papel are written (delivered index.php:41). Strict mode, cookie-only sessions, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Secure on HTTPS are added (index.php:15-21). No contract item changes.

planted.report_excerpt: autenticar calcula md5 da senha e compara diretamente com usuarios.senha. [...] Hashes iguais revelam senhas iguais; após uma cópia do banco, tentativas de senha não precisam passar pelo login e são muito baratas.
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:15-16 explains the fast unsalted hash and offline cracking. It is declared not fixed (corrigido=false), with a transparent-migration plan: VARCHAR(255), legacy MD5 accepted, password_verify and re-hash on login. autenticar still uses md5 (delivered lib.php:15), so C3 is none. C5 is none because nothing was fixed.

planted.report_excerpt: DB_PASS usa uma senha literal quando o ambiente não fornece valor, e SMTP_API_KEY é sempre uma chave literal. Uma cópia do código entrega esses valores a quem obtiver o pacote.
planted.rationale: F4 at config.php:11-15 covers both planted literals (:12, :15). Both literals are out of the code: DB_PASS is getenv('DB_PASS') or '', and SMTP_API_KEY is getenv('SMTP_API_KEY') or '' (delivered config.php:12, :15). Rotation is recommended. Neither secret appears anywhere in the delivery, code, tests or report. C3 is full because both literals are read from the environment with an empty fallback (BL, BT). A mandatory DB_PASS is a deployment requirement, not a defect (BA).

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados e verChamado consultam chamados sem usuario_id; [...] index.php lê uid/papel nas linhas 38–39, mas não os usa nas consultas. Ana consegue abrir ?ver=104, ver títulos de Bruno e baixar seus registros
planted.rationale: F1 is indexed at lib.php:78-101, which spans verChamado (:98-102), the function the dispatcher calls at index.php:53. It names the IDOR on ?ver=104 and the unused uid/papel: the planted flaw, in the same function, with the right mechanism. F1 also covers the listing, the CSV and the SLA average; per the digest, a SEC-017 finding that covers those is scored once, here. The fix is a SQL filter in verChamado (delivered lib.php:114-122, with filtroVisibilidadeChamados at :73-85). A client gets null and 'Chamado nao encontrado.' for a ticket that is not theirs, while technicians and sessionless callers see every ticket. The verChamado(mysqli,int):?array signature is preserved, and filtering in the query is an accepted alternative. C5 is none because the same filter scopes mediaResposta to the logged-in client (delivered lib.php:128-133). That is a COMP-003, charged here as in the earlier verdicts.

planted.report_excerpt: mediaResposta soma somente linhas com minutos_resposta não nulo e divide por qtd sem verificar zero. Banco vazio ou somente respostas nulas deixa qtd = 0; no PHP 8 isso gera DivisionByZeroError
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:109-116 (planted :116). COALESCE(AVG(minutos_resposta), 0), cast to float, returns 0.0 on an empty set (delivered lib.php:130-132); probe corrigida=true. The AVG precision change (25.6667 against 25.666...) is inside the characterization tolerance and is not COMP. The client scoping of the same query comes from the visibility filter and is charged to SEC-017, so C5 stays full.

planted.report_excerpt: Se o diretório não existir ou não for gravável, a função retorna sem CSV; na falha da consulta, retorna sem fechar o arquivo explicitamente.
planted.rationale: F7 (lib.php:125-150, category bug) is a finding about the shared-file race and the fixed directory. Its mechanism also states precisely that the early return on a failed query leaves the file open, which is the planted leak at :133. Per the digest (AE, K, BX), a leak named precisely only inside another (race) finding maps to the row with C1 half and C2 full. The fix: the query now runs before fopen('php://output'), and the write loop sits in try/finally with fclose($fp) (delivered lib.php:153-181), so the handle is closed on every path. No longer writing the on-disk EXPORT_DIR file is not COMP, because the manifest promises only output.

planted.report_excerpt: Cada linha listada chama tecnicoNome, que executa outra consulta em lib.php linha 69 quando tecnico_id não é nulo. A exportação repete o padrão na linha 137.
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:87-90 (planted :89; :137 is named too). A LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') is used in listarChamados and exportarCsv (delivered lib.php:93-95, :153-155), credited once; probe corrigida=true. The '-' placeholder for tickets without a technician is preserved, and tecnicoNome is kept for legacy callers.

The report never names the dispatcher's mix of routing, login, authorization and HTML, either as a finding or in the non-changes list. index.php still does all of it inline (delivered index.php:15-113): an escaparHtml helper and session checks were added in place, with no templates and no thin controller.

Magic numbers are not reported. F12 mentions the 30-minute limit and priority 4 only to describe the nesting, and F12 maps to CLN-007. The non-changes entry 'regras/rótulos de status e prioridade' keeps the rules without calling the literals a smell. Status 1/2 and priority 3/4/30 are still literals (delivered lib.php:29-31, 46-52).

planted.report_excerpt: A combinação de ausência de resposta, prioridade alta, limite de 30 minutos e prioridade 4 fica distribuída por quatro níveis de if/else. A leitura de um retorno exige acompanhar todos os ramos externos, dificultando revisar os limites e futuras alterações de SLA.
planted.rationale: F12 at lib.php:42-58 (planted :43), category qualidade. Rewritten with guard clauses and early returns (delivered lib.php:41-53). The truth table holds for every input: null gives 'Aguardando 1a resposta'; priority < 3 gives 'Normal'; minutes <= 30 gives 'Alto - dentro do SLA'; otherwise priority 4 gives 'CRITICO - SLA estourado' and anything else gives 'Alto - atrasado'. The === 4 test equals == 4 on the int parameter. A grid emulation of both versions found no difference. The target structure is reached and there is no COMP.

extra_findings: F11: array-shaped parameters (login[], senha[], busca[]) reach string-typed lib functions and throw TypeError, and ver[] is cast to id 1 (index.php:21-22, 53, 72). Real and outside the matrix; fixed with is_string checks at the HTTP boundary.

F7, the part beyond its leak clause (the finding is consumed by BUG-004; no separate credit): the export writes and re-reads one shared EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, so concurrent exports can truncate or swap each other's file, ticket data persists on disk, and a missing directory silently yields no CSV (lib.php:125-150). Fixed by streaming to php://output.

F1, the part beyond the detail route (the finding is scored once under SEC-017; no separate credit): the listing and the CSV export were not scoped to the client either (lib.php:78-93, :123-151). Filtering both for clients, while technicians and sessionless callers still see every ticket, is enforcement of the manifest rule, not COMP.

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta is scoped to the logged-in client through filtroVisibilidadeChamados() (delivered lib.php:128-133). On the seed, client bruno's SLA indicator shows 0 min instead of the global 26 min, and the delivery's own tests/regressao.php:85 pins 0.0 for him. Changing which tickets the SLA average covers is the contracted-value change charged in the earlier verdicts of this instance. Technicians and sessionless callers keep the global average (25.6667, inside the tolerance). Charged to SEC-017's C5.

expl_note: Zeros are placeholders: EXPL (step 5) is scored by a separate blind judge, and its scores replace these.
notes: BINDING: achados.json.leb is LEB-100-A / 1.1 / 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625, matching TAREFA.md, the answer key and mecanico.json. .leb-pacote.sha256, manifest.md, TAREFA.md, schema.sql and seed.sql are identical to the original package; only config.php, index.php and lib.php changed, and RELATORIO.md, achados.json and tests/ were added. RELATORIO.md AGAINST achados.json: no inconsistency. Both have the same 12 findings, F1-F12, with identical titles, locations, categories, severities, confidences, fixed flags and mechanism text, and the 7 nao_alterei entries match the Decisions list word for word. MECHANICAL: characterization is 22/22 before and after (no regression), and the four probes (SEC-001, SEC-008, BUG-001, PERF-001) are all corrigida=true. C3 of those four and every C4 come from mecanico.json, so no explicit C4 is written. HESITATIONS: (1) BUG-004. F7's headline is the shared-file race and the fixed directory, and the leak is one precise clause of its mechanism ('na falha da consulta, retorna sem fechar o arquivo explicitamente'). Following the digest (a leak named precisely only inside a race finding maps to the row with C1 half and C2 full: AE, K, BX), C1 is half. A reader taking F7 as a bug-category finding at the right lines could give full, which is worth 1 raw BUG point. (2) SEC-017. F1's JSON location is lib.php:78-101, not index.php:53. It spans verChamado, the function the dispatcher calls at :53, and its mechanism names the ?ver=104 exploit and the unused uid/papel, so I treated it as the same function and gave C1 full. (3) COMP-003 for the SLA scoping. This follows the instance's settled call and is charged to SEC-017's C5. On the seed it changes only bruno's indicator (26 to 0 min), because every answered ticket belongs to ana. JUDGMENT CALLS: F1 also covers the listing, the CSV and the average, but one finding maps to one row (SEC-017). Filtering the listing and the CSV for clients, while technicians and sessionless callers still see every ticket, is enforcement, not COMP. F1's listing/CSV part and F7's race/directory part are recorded as extras with no credit. SEC-001: % and _ are deliberately kept as wildcards; C3 follows the probe (as for BO, BQ, BS) and there is no COMP. listarChamados and verChamado now read through prepared statements and get_result(), so integer columns come back as PHP ints rather than strings. That is inherent to the key's expected fix, broke no characterization check and was never charged in a published verdict, so there is no COMP-002. AVG in SQL for the global average is inside the tolerance and is not COMP; BUG-001's C5 stays full. The on-disk EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv is no longer written (the CSV streams to php://output): not COMP and not PEN. Without a session the library keeps the global view for internal scripts, and index.php requires login before any query; that is recorded as a design risk, not COMP. escaparHtml() uses the PHP 8.1+ default htmlspecialchars flags, so the HTML is unchanged and there is no COMP-006. DB_PASS must now come from the environment: a deployment requirement, not PEN-001 (BA). The CSV sanitizer also neutralizes = + - @ after leading spaces or ASCII control characters and keeps the bare '-' placeholder: hardening, not PEN-001. PEN-001 is 0 because I found no new defect in new code. PEN-003 is 0 because the task is 1.0.0. FALSE POSITIVES AND DECOYS: none. There is no command-execution claim (SEC-009), and extra indexes are only declined as speculative in the Decisions, never reported as a missing-index flaw (PERF-006). NOT REPORTED: ARCH-002 and ARCH-009. EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge, so expl_rubric is zero here.

expl_justification.clareza: Very well organized: the summary fixes conventions up front (original line numbering, findings in fix-priority order, what 'confiança' measures), every finding follows the same template (Local/Categoria/Severidade/Confiança/Corrigido, then Mecanismo, Impacto, Ação e justificativa, Evidência e limites), and Decisões and Validação executada close it with reproducible commands. Minor lapses keep it off 10: a few telegraphic sentences (F3 'aplicado também aos campos textuais já escapados das telas'), a location note filed under F11's 'Evidência e limites', and a loose paragraph after the Decisões list that restates F8/F9.
expl_justification.precisao: No technical error is visible and the depth is high: it declines to claim stacked statements through mysqli::query (F2), keeps HTML escaping apart from SQL binding (F3), pairs session_regenerate_id with strict mode and cookie flags (F5), explains why CHAR(32) truncation rules out a naive hash swap and keeps a constant-time legacy comparison (F6), covers formula prefixes after whitespace and control characters (F8), PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError and AVG ignoring NULL (F9), Com_select as N+1 evidence (F10) and the array-to-int cast (F11), with calibrated confidence (95 where credentials were not tried; MySQL 8 explicitly untested). One point off because the global view kept for session-less library calls is called 'confiável' with no support beyond index.php authenticating first (F1, Decisões).
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has a dedicated 'Mecanismo' that names the cause and walks through how it fails: identity read at index.php 38-39 but never used by the four queries (F1), the payload that closes the LIKE literal (F2), the open/write/close/readfile sequence two requests can interleave (F7), fputcsv protecting structure but not formula semantics (F8), qtd = 0 throwing under PHP 8 (F9), one tecnicoNome query per row (F10). That meets the 'causa + mecanismo' anchor throughout.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings are declared to be in fix-priority order with explicit severity bands (six high, four medium, two low), plus risk qualifiers (exploitation preconditions in F5 and F8, confidence kept separate from likelihood) and one explicit effort-and-risk deferral (F6). Effort is not an axis for the other findings and the order inside each band is never explained, so it sits above 'por severidade' but short of 'severidade × esforço × risco'.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real trade-offs, with a dedicated Decisões section and several alternatives rejected with reasons: an identity parameter versus preserved signatures (global view), pagination/cache/indexes versus JOIN and aggregation, a naive md5 swap or truncation versus progressive migration (F6), 0.0 versus an exception or a new return type (F9), and admitted costs of chosen fixes (apostrophe visible to automated readers). The comparisons are one-liners that justify the chosen option: progressive migration and password reset are named but not weighed against each other, no interim mitigation is weighed for the high risk left open in F6, and the F7/F8 fix designs are not set against alternatives.
